name: Maeda Yuu
source:
Second grader.
She enjoys weekly magazines for women, as well as handsome men.
Being quite well-informed, Yuu has full knowledge of any Baramon High School student's personal information.
Despite being naughty and nosy, she supports the protagonist in his love journey nonetheless
Even though Yuu is a beautiful young girl who is popular in her school, she seems to harbor a certain secret.
